chunks: Abu Ibrahim عليه السلام was asked about a woman who made a bondwoman of hers mudabbar. Then the bondwoman gave birth to a precious slave-girl, and it was not known whether she was mudabbar like her mother or not. So he said: “When did the pregnancy occur—while she was mudabbar, or before the tadbir?”
I said: “May I be your ransom, I do not know. Answer me regarding both cases together.”

He said: “If the bondwoman was pregnant before the tadbir, and what was in her womb was not mentioned, then the bondwoman is mudabbar, while what is in her womb remains in bondage. But if the tadbir was before the pregnancy, and then the pregnancy occurred, then the child is mudabbar along with his mother, because the pregnancy only occurred after the tadbir.”

key_terms.التَّدْبِيرِ: The declaration of delayed emancipation to take effect after death
key_terms.الْحَمْلُ: The pregnancy or fetus in the womb
key_terms.الْوَلَدُ: The child born from the bondwoman
key_terms.مُدَبَّرَةٌ: A female slave designated for emancipation upon the owner's death

ai.seo_question: If a bondwoman is made mudabbar and later gives birth, does her child also become mudabbar?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning tadbir, a form of delayed emancipation, and whether the child of a mudabbar bondwoman shares her status. The ruling depends on the timing of the pregnancy: if it existed before tadbir and was not explicitly included, the fetus remains in bondage; if conception occurred after tadbir, the child follows the mother in being mudabbar.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.3459 - Abu Ibrahim (Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim (as)) was asked about a woman who made her bondwoman mudabbar (to be freed after her death). The bondwoman later gave birth to a precious daughter, and it was unclear whether the child was also mudabbar like her mother or not.
Imam (as) said: "When the pregnancy occurred, was it before or after the tadbir (declaration of delayed emancipation)?"
I said: "May I be your ransom, I do not know. Please answer regarding both situations."

Imam (as) said: "If the bondwoman was pregnant before the tadbir and her pregnancy was not mentioned during the declaration, then the bondwoman is mudabbar, but what is in her womb remains in bondage (not mudabbar).
However, if the tadbir occurred before the pregnancy and then she became pregnant, the child is mudabbar along with her, because the pregnancy occurred after the tadbir."
